verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents inbound parsing that parses incoming emails to your domains and routes them to your application, plus route rules for forwarding or storing. Community users confirm strong inbound handling, and a pricing note that inbound is unavailable on the free plan limits who can use it. missing for 10: documented MX-record setup for receiving, explicit detail on the parsed payload (headers, body, attachments), documented webhook/HTTP POST delivery format for inbound messages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: Inbound Parsing | Parse incoming emails to your domains and route them to your application with ease.
Route Management | Define rules for handling incoming emails, such as forwarding to a specific address or storing the email.
Mailgun allows the ability to send and receive email in both US and EU regions.
They've got the best inbound handling of all of the services out there in terms of letting you apply rules before the messages hit your servers.
